name: Suki!
source:
Hero's mother and father have gone overseas leaving him with his older sister. A new school year starts today and it's time for new opportunities and new love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄的父母去了海外，留下他和姐姐在一起。新学年从今天开始，是时候迎接新机会和新爱情了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
